name: ScrollFillText
description: An Apple-style reading effect: a pinned paragraph inside its own smooth-scroll viewport whose words blend from a dim color to full color one by one in sync with scroll progress.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" with an aria-label, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) and see a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the top/bottom edge wheel events are released so the page keeps scrolling. Touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion (or smooth=false) the wheel is not intercepted at all. The full paragraph is exposed once through a visually hidden span; the per-word spans are aria-hidden. Filling is a color change only; the scroll hint animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

defaultProps.text: Great motion is never decoration. It is a quiet guide that tells you where to look, what just changed, and what comes next. Scroll slowly and watch each word arrive exactly when you do.

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Paragraph that fills word by word.

propsApi.name: dimColor
propsApi.description: Color of words that have not been reached yet.

propsApi.name: fontSize
propsApi.description: Maximum font size in px; shrinks on narrow containers.

propsApi.name: eyebrow
propsApi.description: Small label shown above the paragraph (empty string hides it).

propsApi.name: length
propsApi.description: Scroll distance used for the fill, in viewport heights.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
